levels.description: Master grid movement and learn the first incantation: print().
levels.objective: Command the wizard to wind around the forest obstacles from (1, 4) to the Awakening Altar at (6, 1) and chant print('Lumina')!
levels.starter_code:
# ═══ LESSON 1-1: Winding Movement & print() ═══
# [STEP 1] Walk up 2 tiles from (1, 4) to clear the first crimson trees:
hero.move_up(2)

# [STEP 2] Zigzag around the ruined pillars to reach the altar at (6, 1):
hero.move_right(2)
hero.move_down(1)
hero.move_right(3)
hero.move_up(2)

levels.description: Learn about lists and how to create them.
levels.objective: Return a new list containing the three pixels in their original order. A digital image is a list of RGB pixels; each rune is one pixel. Watch out for winding stalagmites and floor portal traps.
levels.starter_code:
def transform(pixels):
    # [LESSON STEP 1] Read each pixel by its 0-based index: pixels[0], pixels[1], pixels[2]
    # [LESSON STEP 2] Return them inside a new list [ ... ]:
    return [pixels[0], pixels[1], pixels[2]]

pixels = [[220,40,35],[40,200,90],[35,90,220]]
colors = transform(pixels)
for index, color in enumerate(colors):
    hero.cast_color(color[0], color[1], color[2])
    if index == 0:
        hero.move_up(2)
        hero.move_right(3)
    elif index == 1:
        hero.move_up(1)
        hero.move_right(3)
        hero.move_down(3)

levels.description: Learn for loops to iterate over lists.
levels.objective: Brighten every channel by 30, stopping at 255. A for loop applies the same image filter to every pixel. Watch out for winding stalagmites and floor portal traps.
levels.starter_code:
def transform(pixels):
    # [LESSON STEP 1] Create a list to collect transformed pixels:
    result = []
    # [LESSON STEP 2] Loop through each pixel and add 30 to every channel (capped at 255):
    for pixel in pixels:
        result.append([min(255, channel + 30) for channel in pixel])
    return result

pixels = [[50,70,90],[140,40,70],[240,220,200]]
colors = transform(pixels)
for index, color in enumerate(colors):
    hero.cast_color(color[0], color[1], color[2])
    if index < 2:
        # Wind around crystal stalagmites and floor portals.
        hero.move_up(3)
        hero.move_right(3)
        hero.move_down(3)
